title: Pure Naturia
summary: Naturia cards only, with generic Links and staples. Naturia is an EARTH control deck that negates and punishes. Naturia Vein and Naturia Sunflower tribute themselves with another Naturia to negate a Spell/Trap or monster effect, and the Naturia Synchros negate on their own. Naturia Beast stops Spells, Barkion stops Traps, and Landoise stops monster effects. The 2022 cards lead. Naturia Mole Cricket tributes itself on either Main Phase for one or two Naturias from the Deck and returns whenever an Extra Deck monster is summoned. Naturia Camellia is a Level 4 Tuner that mills a Naturia card and revives one when the opponent summons. Naturia Blessing revives a Naturia or Synchro/Fusion Summons on either turn. Naturia Rosewhip is Forbidden and Naturia Sacred Tree is Limited.
